title: Fish eDNA: DNA extraction from water samples filtered through Sterivex filter unit
author: Marine Vautier
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfk8jkzw

steps.title: Defrost Sterivex filter unit
steps.instruction: If the Sterivex™ filter unit has been stored frozen at –20 °C, place it in a 4 °C incubator for 30 minutes to thaw; set the incubator temperature to 37 °C during this period. If the sample was stored at room temperature or 4 °C, skip this step.

steps.title: Vortex cartridge and add lysozyme
steps.instruction: Remove the inlet cap, vortex the Sterivex cartridge for 5 minutes to dislodge particles, then add lysozyme and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Vortex the Sterivex cartridge on a vortex mixer for 00:05:00.
Using a pipette tip, add 40 µL of lysozyme solution into the inlet (the tip should be positioned just above the membrane).
Recap the Sterivex unit.
Incubate the unit at 37 °C for 00:45:00 (place the SDS solution in the incubator for the next step).

steps.title: Add Proteinase K and SDS, incubate
steps.instruction: Add Proteinase K and 20 % SDS, incubate at 55 °C with agitation, then collect the lysate.

substeps.instruction: Remove the inlet cap.
Add 50 µL of Proteinase K solution and 100 µL of 20 % SDS into the inlet.
Recap the Sterivex unit.
Incubate at 55 °C for 02:00:00 with agitation (or shake manually every 15 minutes).
After incubation, remove the inlet cap, attach a sterile syringe to the inlet, and aspirate the liquid back and forth to collect all lysate.
Transfer the lysate into two 2 mL microcentrifuge tubes (≈1.1 mL per tube).
Note: place Buffer SE in a 55 °C incubator now to pre‑heat for the later elution step.

steps.title: Add Buffer SL3 and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Treat each lysate tube with Buffer SL3, vortex briefly, chill, and spin down debris.

substeps.instruction: To each 2 mL tube add 200 µL of Buffer SL3.
Vortex for 00:00:02.
Incubate at 4 °C for 00:05:00 (in a refrigerator).
Centrifuge at 11 000 × g for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Inhibitor removal column processing
steps.instruction: Pass the cleared supernatant through a NucleoSpin® Inhibitor Removal Column, collecting flow‑through until all supernatant is processed.

substeps.instruction: Place a NucleoSpin® Inhibitor Removal Column (red ring) into a 2 mL collection tube.
Load up to 650 µL of clear supernatant onto the column.
Centrifuge at 11 000 × g for 1 minute.
Collect the flow‑through in a clean tube.
Repeat loading, centrifugation, and collection until all supernatant from step 3 is filtered (approximately four tubes total).
If a pellet forms after centrifugation, transfer only the clear supernatant to a new tube before continuing.
Discard the Inhibitor Removal Column after use.

steps.title: Add Buffer SB to flow‑through
steps.instruction: Mix each flow‑through tube with Buffer SB, vortex briefly, and spin down.

substeps.instruction: To each 2 mL tube add 250 µL of Buffer SB (0.38 vol Buffer SB per 1 vol flow‑through).
Close the lid, vortex for 00:00:05, and centrifuge briefly (≈10 seconds) at 11 000 × g.

steps.title: Bind DNA to Soil column
steps.instruction: Load the Buffer SB‑treated samples onto a single NucleoSpin® Soil Column, washing the column between loads.

substeps.instruction: Place a NucleoSpin® Soil Column (green ring) into a 2 mL collection tube.
Load 650 µL of sample from step 6 onto the column.
Centrifuge at 11 000 × g for 1 minute.
Discard the flow‑through and return the column to the same collection tube.
Repeat the load‑centrifuge‑discard cycle for all remaining tubes using the same column.

steps.title: Wash Soil column (four washes)
steps.instruction: Perform sequential washes of the Soil column with the specified buffers.

substeps.instruction: 1st wash: Add 500 µL Buffer SB, centrifuge at 11 000 × g for 30 seconds, discard flow‑through, return column to collection tube.
2nd wash: Add 550 µL Buffer SW1, centrifuge at 11 000 × g for 30 seconds, discard flow‑through, return column.
3rd wash: Add 650 µL Buffer SW2, vortex for 00:00:02, centrifuge at 11 000 × g for 30 seconds, discard flow‑through, return column.
4th wash: Add 650 µL Buffer SW2, vortex for 00:00:02, centrifuge at 11 000 × g for 30 seconds, discard flow‑through, return column.

steps.title: Final spin and dry column
steps.instruction: Spin the column to remove residual wash buffer and dry the membrane.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 11 000 × g for 2 minutes.
If any liquid contacts the column after this spin, discard the flow‑through and repeat the 2‑minute spin.

steps.title: Elute DNA from Soil column
steps.instruction: Elute DNA with pre‑heated Buffer SE and collect the eluate.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the Soil column into a new 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Add 30 µL Buffer SE (pre‑heated to 55 °C) directly onto the column.
Do not close the lid; incubate at room temperature (18–25 °C) for 00:01:30.
Close the lid and centrifuge at 11 000 × g for 30 seconds.
Collect the eluate (DNA solution) from the tube; discard the column.
Optional: perform a second elution with another 30 µL Buffer SE (DNA concentration will be lower).

steps.title: Store extracted DNA
steps.instruction: Freeze the purified DNA until use.

substeps.instruction: Store the DNA at –20 °C (or at –40 °C to –80 °C for long‑term storage).
